description: LEAP-2020: Cyclic Triaxial and Direct Simple Shear Tests Performed at GWU is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Majid Manzari, George Washington University (gwu.edu). The results of strain-controlled cyclic triaxial and cyclic direct simple shear tests performed on Ottawa F65 sand at the George Washington University Geotechnical Engineering laboratory are archived here. The datasets for triaxial tests are published as a separate experiment. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Cyclic Direct Simple Shear Test, Liquefaction, Sand, Stress-strain response. Published 2021-01-28. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
